acquisition_manifest.note: Digest was recorded by the local audit receipt; it has not been compared with an independent trusted digest, signature, or separately approved registry.

audit_receipt.scope: Prior local receipt for the fixed DEVELOPMENT artifact; rerun the updated audit after the interval-boundary fix before relying on its pass status.

limitations: Duplicate rows are preserved; they are not deduplicated or sorted.
Zero Last/Volume values are not interpreted as trade prints or traded volume.
Observed counts originate from the prior local receipt and must be reconfirmed with a new receipt after the updated audit is run.

review_checklist: Verify artifact SHA-256, byte size, and row count against the local source artifact.
Rerun the updated audit and attach the newly generated receipt hash without overwriting earlier evidence.
Independently establish manifest provenance or explicitly accept it as unanchored acquisition metadata.
Review duplicate timestamp groups, gaps, and zero Last/Volume semantics.
Approve or reject DEVELOPMENT registration explicitly; this proposal itself is not registration.
